Arduino-Based Smart Parking System

## 1\. Statement

## The Smart Parking System is designed to automate vehicle entry and exit in a parking area. An Arduino Uno controls the system, while a servo motor operates the parking gate. An LCD display shows the parking status, and LED and buzzer provide visual and audio indications to improve user awareness.

## 2\. Materials Required

&nbsp;

Arduino Uno

Servo Motor

LCD Display

LED

Buzzer

Resistor

Breadboard

Jumper Wires

Power Supply / USB Cable

## 3\. Procedure

&nbsp;

Connect the LCD display, servo motor, LED, and buzzer to the Arduino Uno.

Program the Arduino to control the parking gate.

The servo motor acts as the automatic gate mechanism.

The LCD displays messages such as “PARKING AVAILABLE”, “VEHICLE ENTRY”, or “PARKING FULL.”

The LED indicates the current parking status.

The buzzer provides an audio alert during gate operation or when required.

The Arduino coordinates all components to provide an automated parking-system demonstration.

## 4\. Working

&nbsp;

The Arduino Uno acts as the main controller. Based on the programmed parking condition, it controls the servo motor and updates the LCD display. The LED provides a visual status indication, while the buzzer gives an audio alert. The servo motor opens or closes the parking gate according to the system condition.

## 5\. Advantages

&nbsp;

Automatic gate control

Simple and low-cost design

Real-time parking status display

Visual and audio indication

Easy to expand for multiple parking slots
